description:
Overview 
 We are seeking a Firmware/Hardware Engineer to support the development, analysis, and enhancement of embedded systems and low-level software across a variety of platforms. This role sits at the intersection of hardware and software, focusing on firmware development, reverse engineering, and system-level problem solving.
 This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy working close to the hardware, breaking down complex systems, and uncovering how things operate at a fundamental level.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop, modify, and debug firmware for embedded systems across diverse hardware architectures 
 Perform reverse engineering of binaries, firmware, and hardware-integrated software components 
 Analyze system behavior at the hardware/firmware interface to identify vulnerabilities or performance improvements 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement low-level solutions 
 Support testing, validation, and troubleshooting of firmware in real-world environments 
 Document findings, methodologies, and technical implementations 
 
 
 
 
 Requirements 
 Required Qualifications
 Strong proficiency in C programming, particularly in embedded or low-level environments 
 Experience performing reverse engineering across multiple architectures (e.g., ARM, x86, MIPS) 
 Solid understanding of computer architecture, memory management, and hardware/software interaction 
 Experience working in Linux or Unix-based environments 
 Ability to debug and analyze systems at a low level 
 
 Desired Skills
 Experience with vulnerability research or identifying security weaknesses in firmware or embedded systems 
 Hands-on experience analyzing or developing firmware 
 Familiarity with reverse engineering tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or similar 
 Experience with embedded debugging tools (e.g., JTAG, UART, logic analyzers) 
 Understanding of common firmware formats, bootloaders, and device communication protocols 
 Exposure to secure coding practices and exploit mitigation techniques 
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working with embedded devices, IoT systems, or custom hardware platforms 
 Familiarity with assembly languages and low-level debugging 
 Background in cybersecurity, embedded security, or hardware security 
 Experience integrating firmware with hardware components in production or lab environments 
 Benefits 
 401K: up to 3% discretionary profit sharing contribution + 100% match on the 1st 7% of pay
 PTO: 20 days per year
 Healthcare, dental, vision, Free for a single participant
 $50,000 Life insurance provided, additional voluntary life insurance available
 
 InterImage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. InterImage provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
